heroi.subtitulo: Preparation, coordination and follow-up of your building works.

apresentacao.titulo: Renovations, houses, apartment buildings. We prepare the project, track the costs and run the site.
apresentacao.paragrafo1: STOA Management is a construction management office based in Farvagny-le-Grand, in the canton of Fribourg.
apresentacao.paragrafo2: From structural work to finishing, we coordinate how the project unfolds and step in where needed.
apresentacao.paragrafo3: More than ten years in this field have given us solid knowledge and a sense of priorities.

destaque.intro: A selection of projects, from excavation to façade.

especialidades.intro: Three skills, from the project to the site.

preparacao.resumo: Preliminary design, planning application, construction drawings, building costs, tenders.
preparacao.detalhe: Everything decided before the site opens: the project takes shape, permits are applied for, costs are estimated and contractors are consulted.

financas.resumo: Monitoring and control of construction costs.
financas.detalhe: Costs are tracked throughout construction, so that every decision is made knowing its effect on the budget.

direcao.resumo: Coordination and intervention as the project unfolds.
direcao.detalhe: On site, construction management organises the contractors’ work, follows progress and steps in when a decision is needed.

metodo.intro: Construction management is built in order.
